Hi!

A plays "Bum's Rush" on B.
A plays Thoughts Betrayed.

Can B tap "Elysium, The Arboretum" to end combat immediatly?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In article <35826...@news.ip.pt>, Luis P. Duarte <Luis....@ip.pt>
writes

>Hi!
>
>A plays "Bum's Rush" on B.
>A plays Thoughts Betrayed.
>
>Can B tap "Elysium, The Arboretum" to end combat immediatly?
>

Well, the Methuselah controlling B can yes.

Thoughts Betrayed only stops cards going from your hand. Since the
Elysium is in play, it can be tapped to end combat. (However, anyone
playing TB can see it and has probably planned for it.... you end this
combat, you don't have Elysium to end the next combat he starts, so
watch out).

--

Yes. I've thought of that fact.
But what's important for me is that if i have Elysium untapped, i want
the other Player to see it clearly. If he plays a TB, he wastes one
precious card, since i'll tap the Elysium.
If he don't I can play MY cards! This could give me some advantage:
if it's not my turn then i'll play TB instead of him!

Thanks for the answer.
